summary.text:
The Ease class provides a collection of easing functions for use with tween.js.
缓动函数集合，用于动画过渡效果。

content.text: Values are intended for normalized progress in the range [0, 1].

text.comment:
Circular easing functions.

Remarks:

Values are intended for normalized progress in the range [0, 1].

content.text: Normalized progress, normally in the range [0, 1].

text.comment:
Linear easing functions.

Param:

Normalized progress, normally in the range [0, 1].

Returns:

The interpolated progress.

Example:
Easing.Linear.None(0.5); // 0.5

summary.text:
Quadratic easing functions.
Each function accepts normalized progress, normally in the range [0, 1].

text.comment:
Quadratic easing functions. Each function accepts normalized progress, normally in the range [0, 1].

Example:
Easing.Quadratic.In(0.5); // 0.25
Easing.Quadratic.Out(0.5); // 0.75

The Ease class provides a collection of easing functions for use with tween.js. 缓动函数集合，用于动画过渡效果。
